propositions: Stale blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural remain unresolved on read and distort ready, next-batch and parent-first claims; 18 such edges detected in repository tracker.

rebar doctor scans net-active blocking edges against the current resolver to classify findings (ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable) and repair by writing replacement links before unlinking stale ones.

Repair refuses to run during in-flight reconciler passes, writes no store-wide lock (each event write acquires and releases its own flock), and declines ambiguous pairs where unlink would cancel a different relation.

Residual findings after repair whose source endpoint is closed cannot be rewritten by add_dependency (correct behavior) but are inert for scheduling since closed tickets never appear in ready/next-batch.
Link-audit became the first check of rebar doctor after a standalone verb was rejected for core; command renamed from link-audit to doctor with dedicated dispatcher arm and init_only flag.

Re-parenting silently invalidates previously-correct edges without touching links themselves, causing new mis-escalated findings to appear after remediation; doctor serves as backstop rather than primary defense.
